description.value: Lee's House Asian Fusion Bistro is a Victoria restaurant operated by professional chefs from Taiwan and Hong Kong, serving authentic Hong Kong dim sum made fresh daily alongside Sichuan, Cantonese, and Taiwanese dishes. Signature items include House Special Fried Rice, Assorted Seafood Chow Mein, and Sichuan Spicy Chili Chicken, complemented by traditional Taiwanese pineapple honey drinks and pearl milk tea. Situated in a strip mall on Shelbourne Street, it offers casual family dining with online ordering and takeout.
